method: float-shadow min/max on caller-supplied training representatives
scope: Numerical interface only; training lineage is bound by the checkpoint-derived wrapper

float_shadow.reference: untouched pinned converted StreamGTCRN on identical spectra and reset states

localization.scope: Training-only numerical localization; no sensitivity recovery, changed grids, development calibration or quality claim

interpretation.propagated: Integer decoded edge versus original float graph on identical spectra; includes upstream error
interpretation.float_edge_grid_only: Original float edge quantized once on its assigned encoding; isolates boundary resolution/range
interpretation.total_local: Actual integer output versus original float operator on actual decoded integer inputs and prior state
interpretation.after_reference_output_rounding: Same local reference rounded to actual output encoding; exposes weight/internal arithmetic effects
interpretation.integer_rail_contacts: Contacts include valid endpoints and do not establish clipping
interpretation.integer_zero_codes: A signed probability code of zero means128/255, not a zero probability
interpretation.ranking: Relative L2 may be unstable on near-zero references; inspect reference RMS and absolute error alongside it
interpretation.limits: Does not independently toggle classes to float or attribute waveform SI-SDR causally; residual/reshape errors appear in edge statistics

source_code.train_py_note: Recorded for immutable-source-bundle review; not required to equal current train.py because unrelated loss/guard edits change its hash.

source_audit.verification_scope: Training manifests match checkpoint hashes/counts; both partitions match adjacent preparation provenance. Source audio bytes are not rehashed here; extra validation hashes are audited now, not embedded training-time commitments.

hash_scope: Selected synthetic file hashes verified against preparation; paired file hashes recorded now; crop hashes cover little-endian float32 samples including padding
development_manifest_usage: Audit of split/IDs/source overlap only; no development audio read or parameters fitted
